fusions.name: Wild Mote
fusions.desc: Flicks an arcane spore at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Spell Impetus] for 8 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Unbound Burst
fusions.desc: A burst of arcane spores deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring resistances, and leaves each [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Far Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further. You regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Feedback Loop
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you regain 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
